title: A finite field extension admits a finite algebra model over the power-series polynomial ring
statement: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$, let $n,m\ge0$ and let $A=k[[x_1,\ldots,x_n]][y_1,\ldots,y_m]$ be the polynomial ring [def-weil-polynomial-ring] in $y_1,\ldots,y_m$ over the formal power series ring $k[[x_1,\ldots,x_n]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Then $A$ is an integral domain; let $K=A_{(0)}$ be its fraction field [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], and let $M/K$ be a finite field extension [def-pc-field-extension], i.e. $M$ is a finitely generated $K$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Then there is a subring $B\subseteq M$ containing $A$ which is a finitely generated $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and whose fraction field is $M$ (every element of $M$ is $b/s$ with $b,s\in B$, $s\neq0$).

proof.text: Construct B = Algebra.adjoin A (Set.range e). Set.finite_range and integrality of each basis vector imply Module.Finite A B by Algebra.finite_adjoin_of_finite_of_isIntegral, the Mathlib realization of lem-weil-pbc-finite-of-integral-generators.

proof.text: For z in M apply IsLocalization.exist_integer_multiples_of_finite to its finite family of basis coordinates. It gives d in nonZeroDivisors A and numerators a_i with algebraMap A K a_i = d smul e.repr z i. The scalar tower, injectivity A to K and injectivity K to M imply algebraMap A M d is nonzero. Rewrite d smul z by e.sum_repr and Finset.smul_sum; each summand is a_i smul e_i in B by subset_adjoin and B.smul_mem, so the sum lies in B. The element algebraMap A M d lies in B by algebraMap_mem. Cancel its nonzero image to conclude z = (d smul z) / algebraMap A M d.
